name: basic_fix_pr_comments
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill
fetches review comments from the current PR
executes the 10-phase remediation workflow
resolves threads after applying fixes

name: address_pr_feedback
input: address the PR feedback and push fixes
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill from natural language
applies code changes based on review feedback
creates a conventional commit for remediation
pushes changes to remote branch

name: specific_pr_number
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill with PR number argument
fetches comments for PR #123 specifically
does not auto-detect PR from current branch
checks out the correct branch for PR #123

name: auto_mode
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill in auto mode
applies fixes without user confirmation for high-confidence items
uses default confidence threshold
skips interactive prompts for accepted changes
still flags low-confidence items for review

name: custom_confidence_threshold
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill with custom confidence threshold
uses 85 as the confidence cutoff instead of default
auto-applies fixes scoring above 85
flags fixes scoring below 85 for manual review

name: skip_rebase_flag
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill with --skip-rebase flag
skips the rebase-onto-base-branch phase
applies fixes directly on current branch state
still executes all other phases of the workflow

name: dry_run_mode
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill in dry-run mode
analyzes and scores all comments
does NOT apply any code changes
does NOT create commits or push
shows planned actions for each comment

name: force_push_flag
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill with --force flag
uses git push --force-with-lease for pushing
does NOT use bare --force for safety
force push is required after rebase rewrites history

name: ten_phase_workflow_order
input: fix all the review comments on my PR end to end
assertions: triggers the pr-fix skill with full pipeline
executes phases in order: fetch, analyze, rebase, apply, test, commit, push, reply, resolve, report
rebase onto base branch happens before applying fixes
thread resolution happens after pushing changes
uses conventional commit message for remediation

name: negative_create_pr
assertions: does NOT trigger the pr-fix skill
triggers the pr skill instead
recognized as a creation task not a remediation task

name: negative_just_rebase
assertions: does NOT trigger the pr-fix skill
recognized as a standalone rebase task
no PR comment remediation involved
